title: Judgment against Elam
description: At the beginning of Zedekiah's reign, the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah concerning Elam. God promises to break Elam's bow, scatter its people to the four winds, send the sword after them, and set His throne in Elam by bringing an end to the king and the nobles. Yet He also promises to restore Elam's fortunes in the last days.
